implementation_requirements.operation_semantics: Only submit-operation executes project code, including observe. Existing read-state reads durable session status; no status endpoint. open/transfer/reattach/close lifecycle calls never evaluate/load/run project code. poll/cancel only observe/request control; cancellation is not confirmed stopping.
implementation_requirements.request_identity: Describe existing operation_id, session_id, expected_generation{counter,nonce}, expected_lease_epoch, requester{principal_kind,role,agent_id}, contract_id/step_key/attempt, kind/payload, context{working_dir,namespace,reader/test config refs}, limits. These abstract adapter inputs map to existing schema records; not new required schema fields.
implementation_requirements.vocabulary: Kinds exactly load_source,compile_source,evaluate,run_tests,observe. Terminal statuses completed,condition_signalled,cancelled,terminated,rejected; nonterminal running,cancel_requested,unknown. debugger_paused is optional and not emitted in v1, never a new schema status. wait_outcome stopped_waiting preserves outstanding execution and busy lane.

conditional_checks.S1: Existing session/operation schemas validate records; record validity proves no live behavior.
conditional_checks.S2: Reject stale generation or lease before execution, with correct current owner/requester identity.

conditional_checks.S4: Timeout stops waiting only and never reports execution stopped.
conditional_checks.S5: Capture conditions/restarts before unwind; failed partial load cannot claim image consistency.
conditional_checks.S6: Review trials receive no endpoint/permission and requests are rejected before execution.
conditional_checks.S7: Lifecycle calls never evaluate project code.
conditional_checks.S8: Session results/provenance are never acceptance evidence; acceptance remains fresh process/build/hermetic independent QA.
conditional_checks.S9: A new process/generation/subagent/stage does not reset contract_id/step_key/attempt or Parent-owned counters.
